summary: REVISE. The timeout implementation is otherwise narrow and coherent: 14,400 seconds feeds the existing single linked whole-Repository profile deadline; 510 minutes is allowed only when the internal command name is exactly provisioner-run; every other command retains the 45-minute maximum and one-tick-over rejection; the exact seven-slot Pass 2 payload is unchanged. The base-to-candidate path set contains no production Scan parser/filter/scheduler/group/retry/dispatch implementation, migration/model, Docker topology, provider identity, package identity, Dockerfile, compose, or requirements-lock change. Focused non-live timeout/closed-contract/Pass-2 tests passed 3/3, the Web build exited zero, and the workflow validator passed; no prohibited live resource was acquired. The technical report truthfully states that official CodeGraphContext material publishes no average and that community durations are low-confidence observations. However, three unresolved High evidence/boundary failures remain: stale ignored T072 candidate metadata, a failed mandatory diff check, and missing contract-complete durable RED/GREEN evidence.
